prompt:
Warm, proud family statement T-shirt print, portrait, isolated on a plain empty background.

The role word is the hero and reads exactly "{rolle}" in big, bold, heartfelt lettering.
[[Right with the role, a personal name reads exactly "{name}".]]
[[A line below reads exactly "{spruch}".]]
[[A smaller line lists exactly "{namen}".]]

The accent motif and the arrangement follow the variation given below. Cozy, proud, gift-worthy look.

Style: bold friendly lettering, warm palette plus cream, thick outlines, small tasteful accents, no photorealism, no gradients.
